about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord Jesus Christ, may the sacrifices of which we have partaken, while devoutly celebrating the piercing of Your Virgin Mother’s soul, obtain for us, through Your kindness, the effect of every saving good. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
